cases: Crash after Site row insert but before dedicated Dispatch Location/link: whole CreateSite UoW rolls back.
LLD-02 DispatchLocationService failure inside CreateSite: no Site/Dispatch/link/receipt survives.
Site ownership correction validator becomes BLOCKED between preview and commit: correction rolls back.
Site archive validator returns INDETERMINATE: no lifecycle event or archive mutation persists.
Crash after Rack descriptive update before history event/projection completion: transaction rolls back.
Rack height race adds placement after preview: writer revalidation detects out-of-range and aborts.
Two concurrent placements target same free U range: only one commits; other gets stale/occupied.
Cross-Site Rack substituted after preview: placement transaction fails before event/current write.
Crash after Network Element identity row but before initial unracked placement: creation rolls back.
Optional Cloud/IP/Model child reducer fails during Network Element creation: entire requested creation rolls back.
Regularize create-and-link fails after receipt but before new Network Element creation: receipt and all children roll back.
Regularize create-and-link fails after new Network Element but before resolution row: new element rolls back.

Invalid/expired/already-consumed or stale-bound DeliberateActionProof fails inside the authoritative UnitOfWork before Infrastructure mutation; a second use of the same proof cannot authorize another regularization and leaves no new receipt/domain event.
Device Reference resolution changes after preview: commit returns stale and preserves current resolution; proof is not consumed against stale business state.
Containment parent changes after preview producing cycle: writer re-walk catches cycle and aborts.
Existing corrupt containment repeated-node chain: operation fails closed INDETERMINATE and changes nothing.
Concurrent containment move attempts: current-child revision/cardinality allows at most one winner.
Cloud Deployment archived between preview and assignment: assignment aborts.
Cloud Deployment Site changed/corrupted incompatibly: same-Site validation fails closed.
Crash between unsetting old primary IP and setting new primary: one UoW rollback preserves old primary.
Concurrent primary IP changes: revision/unique constraint prevents two current primaries.
IP address correction collides with existing same-element canonical IP: correction aborts with history unchanged.
IP parsing exception/unsupported zone identifier: no identity/event row created.
Crash after Model assignment event before current relation update: whole transaction rolls back.
Compatibility mutation fails current-relation update: appended event rolls back.
Maintenance component registration sees stale Inventory physical-consequence fingerprint: no component/event persists.
InventoryPhysicalConsequenceReader returns INDETERMINATE: maintenance component mutation fails closed.
Concurrent component installs to same known slot: only one current installed component commits.
Crash after new replacement component identity before install event: replacement identity rolls back.
Device Part Unit resolution target changes after preview: writer validate_target rejects stale/invalid link.
Workbook source locked during stabilization: bounded failed run/file result, no domain mutation/source modification.

Workbook parsing crashes mid-file: recovery never resumes the in-memory parser; only exact checkpointed source identity and committed row fingerprints may be reused, otherwise unpublished technical staging is failed/cleaned and reparsed with no domain mutation.

Crash during staging batch persistence: the validating run remains non-authoritative; recovery reopens from row 2, verifies every committed row fingerprint through the durable per-sheet cursor, then continues only if the exact source SHA-256/stable metadata still match, so no duplicate/mixed-generation rows become reviewable.
Workbook proposal calculation fails: no domain state changes; run records bounded failure.
Accepted workbook batch fails after first domain service mutation: entire outer UoW rolls back all row mutations.
Workbook target revision changes after review: acceptance aborts whole selected mutation set.
Workbook containment becomes cyclic only at commit-time due to concurrent change: acceptance rolls back.
Workbook Rack occupancy becomes conflicting after review: acceptance rolls back.
Workbook same-installation ID points to archived/invalid target at commit: acceptance rolls back.
Workbook replay-index insert fails after domain mutations: entire acceptance UoW rolls back, preventing unindexed duplicate mutation.
Crash after workbook acceptance commit before staging cleanup: authoritative accepted state remains valid; cleanup is safely retryable.
Staging cleanup accidentally targets pending run: guard rejects deletion and preserves review payload.
Audit/result write fails in any Infrastructure command: owning mutation rolls back.
Command receipt duplicate with same idempotency identity replays prior result and does not duplicate events.
Command receipt duplicate with conflicting payload is rejected per LLD-01 idempotency rules.
Database FK/STRICT constraint failure at any child row: whole UoW rolls back.
Site-derived Dispatch address provider unavailable on read: display reports bounded unavailable state and does not copy stale address into master.
Archive blocker enumeration query fails outside writer lock: UI shows bounded error; archive command still independently fails closed if guard cannot prove CLEAR.

Crash while INFRA_WORKBOOK_EXPORT_V1 is writing/verifying an unpublished temp workbook: recovery trusts only the committed export_id/temp_filename checkpoint, removes only the proven job-owned sibling temp artifact, and restarts from a fresh stable read snapshot; no export evidence or operator-file mutation is fabricated.

Crash after temp workbook verification but before atomic publication: recovery reopens only the exact owned temp candidate and requires profile/hash/size equality before reuse; mismatch causes owned-temp discard/regeneration and never publishes unverified bytes.

Crash after atomic workbook publication but before infrastructure_workbook_exports evidence commit: recovery never rewrites/deletes the final file; exact final filename/hash/size must match the committed checkpoint before the single export evidence row is recorded idempotently, otherwise recovery fails closed.

Export cancellation races publication: cancellation before publication closes/removes only a proven owned temp artifact; once atomic publication begins it cannot interleave with rename and post-publication cancellation must finish evidence reconciliation without deleting/retracting the operator-managed final workbook.

Crash during INFRA_WORKBOOK_STAGE_V1 validating-to-staged publication: before commit the run remains validating and cannot appear reviewable; after commit exact persisted run identity makes recovery skip publication idempotently without duplicate proposals or a second reviewable run.

Stage-job cancellation during parsing/staging/publishing: an unpublished validating candidate is failed/cleaned only at a safe checkpoint, publication transaction cannot be interrupted, and any already-published staged/reviewed run remains reviewable and is never retracted or accepted automatically.

Import directory/candidate manifest or current-file stable identity changes after an interrupted staging checkpoint: recovery resets discovery or fails the unpublished validating generation and reparses from a fresh exact identity while persisted already-published runs are idempotently skipped; rows from different workbook generations are never mixed.
expected: No injected failure may leave a partial authoritative mutation, fabricated relationship, weakened identity inference, mixed-generation review staging or unindexed accepted workbook mutation.
transaction_focus: Receipt-FK ordering, same-UoW cross-domain participants, projection/event atomicity, concurrency revalidation, durable workbook export publication/recovery, durable workbook staging/checkpoint/publication recovery and post-commit technical cleanup are all covered.
